name: Pane
text: The static map risks users missing critical updates because color alone can’t compete with motion for attention—like a fire alarm that doesn’t sound. A hybrid approach—pulses only for high-priority events, static for low—would preserve liveliness without training users to ignore everything. Settle it with a test tracking response time to urgent vs. routine data in both versions.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Use a *hybrid radial graph*—pulses for high-priority events, static color shifts for low—balancing liveliness and sustained visibility without training users to ignore updates.

Result: A dark-themed interface where critical changes demand attention, while routine data stays visible but unobtrusive. Owned by Facet.
